svg.text: Good planning balances clear priorities with room to adapt.
Our team was under the gun to organize a weekend event. We needed to streamline the booking process
and grasp the practical constraints. After we zeroed in on the main problem, we discussed what we would
“Let’s leave some room for flexibility,” I suggested. Were it not for our backup plan, a change in the weather
would force us to cancel. When a friend asked about plans I was looking forward to, I explained how we had
We can prepare carefully without expecting every detail to go perfectly.
